about: Key bootstrap and rotation for the PrompTugal section repositories, with no person in the per-repository loop. PrompTugal__IaC acts (merge one key pull request, set and later delete the anchor variable) only on cl-6.security's detached-signed approval of that pull request's exact head SHA and diff, read from its home. Changes to this file are Dinis's: he merges them. Design: PrompTugal__Agent__Security docs/security/2026-11-26-section-repos-key-bootstrap.md (6fbdbc8).
source: Dinis, 26 Nov 2026, via cl-6.conductor: "note that I cannot be in-line in the normal publishing workflow, only for escalations and massive exceptions." Designed by cl-6.security@PrompTugal.dinis with cl-6.infra@PrompTugal.dinis.

successors.rule: A new approver key is accepted only through statement n, signed (namespace promptugal-key-approval) by the key in force after statement n-1 (the pinned key for n = 1), naming the new key, its fingerprint and its session. The job follows the chain from the pinned key and trusts only its last link. If the chain breaks, only a change to this file by Dinis restores an approver: an escalation.

keys_rule: team/keys.json, in the repository's own dialect (repository_config): exactly one new entry for the approval's agent and session, its key at key_path equal to the home's key, its status exactly active_status (or no status when null), never superseded; earlier entries change only by being retired in superseded_style, and only entries of the same role; nothing else in the file changes
commit_rule: the pull request's head commit is signed by the new key (the home's ssh_ed25519 or ssh, by the key's type), with one Agent: trailer equal to the agent and one Claude-Session: trailer equal to its session

anchor.value: the merge commit SHA on dev
anchor.removed: after the first push run on dev after the merge whose checks job passed, or after 24 hours, whichever is first

gate_status.rule: dev: success when the commits from the repository's anchor A to the head leave the paths untouched; work/*: the same from dev to the head. When touched, success only with cl-6.security's signed approval of that head SHA. Failure when A is unknown, or the compared file list holds 300 or more files (the API cuts it) (B5).
gate_status.paths_note: every file pages.yml copies from A (the whole scripts/ and .gitattributes) and the workflows and keys (B4)
gate_status.advance: On a work/** head: success and a strict fast-forward of dev (compare ahead, behind_by 0) moves dev to it, force false, after re-reading dev and the status; failure creates tag gate/<agent>/<sha12>-fail. Never a force update, never another branch, never a tag deletion.
gate_status.agent_push: An agent pushes work/<agent> only, never dev. After a rebase it re-pushes with --force-with-lease on its own work/<agent> and nowhere else (ABP P19); each new SHA is judged afresh. The App never force-updates any ref.

log.where: each run's summary and its plan artifact (90 days)
log.note: no committed log file: committing would need App write on PrompTugal__IaC (accepted by cl-6.security, 26 Nov 2026)

never: act without a verified approval of the exact head SHA and diff hash
merge anything but the approved head SHA
change the approver or this file
hold a token wider than the step needs
repository_config_note: Per repository, read from its own scripts/check-signatures.mjs on dev (26 Nov 2026): anchor_job, the jobs a pages.yml push run on dev must all pass to be A; key_path, the field of a team/keys.json entry that its check reads; key_encoding, ssh (an OpenSSH line) or pem (an SPKI PEM, converted to OpenSSH: ed25519 or P-256); also_equal, a second field that, when present, must hold the same key; active_status, the status a new entry must carry (null: no status field); superseded_style, how an old entry is retired: status (status "superseded") or field (a superseded time). The key is compared with the home's ssh_ed25519 when it is ed25519 and with the home's ssh when it is P-256. Travel: its checks read no key file, so key_path is null and its pull request may change pinned files only, not team/keys.json.
pages_rule: Each repository's anchor-override pages.yml is pinned whole by sha256 in the approver's signed pins file, because the eight pages.yml files differ (B2).
merge_rule: Before merging: the pull request's base.sha equals dev's head, and dev's head equals the repository's last verified anchor (the latest pages.yml push run on dev whose anchor_job passed). After merging: the merged commit's tree equals the approved head's tree, or no anchor is set (B1).

pins.where: PrompTugal/PrompTugal__Agent__Security approvals/pins/<repo>.json (+ .sig), signed in the approver namespace by the approver key in force
pins.rule: Only files listed for that repository in pinnable_files can be pinned; a pin for any other file is ignored and reported. A key pull request may change team/keys.json and pinned files only, each with exactly the pinned content. Dinis's merge of this policy accepts that cl-6.security (or its successor under the chain) decides those files' reviewed content, as it decides gate approvals.
pins.source: cl-6.security, 26 Nov 2026 06:20 UTC: "No second Dinis merge for pins ... The pins are the same kind of decision as the gate approvals I already sign."
